checks.statement: bounded point-jet stages have triangular dimension
the finite-order jet union is strict
point jets obey s>k+1 in two dimensions
a delta fails at the H^-1 endpoint
a codimension-one measure has local threshold s>1/2
l1 atomic weights converge in total variation
non-l1 accumulating atoms do not form a finite measure
the real magnetic characteristic cone has four dyad lines

verdict: Finite jets form a strict LF source, Radon measures are a total-variation closure of atomic flux packets, and point derivatives require progressively more negative Sobolev order. The full distribution carrier and characteristic wavefront sectors are representable enlargements, not source-authorized completions.
